messages.subject: Predictor variables for random slopes
parts:
Dear Phil,

I am asking for help about adding predictor variables to random slope for multilevel IRT models.

For random part, I used "random = ~ 1 + prior_score|group". It works well with the individual-level predictor " prior_score " and grouping variable "group".

Now I want to add a school (group) level predictor "school_type" to the random slope of " prior_score ". I looked up the mirt help and examples, but still cannot figure out how to modify the code.

Your help is most appreciated. Thanks a lot.

CW

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Predictor variables for random slopes
parts:
You should include this explanatory variable into the fixed argument as the goal would be to explain the residual variation given the fixed effect predictors. Something that varies within the level of the group (school) to see if the predictor is significant, has a large enough effect size, and reduces the residual variance terms in some meaningful way.

Phil
